CVE-2026-56741 is a CPU-exhaustion DoS in JLine's remote-telnet Telnet server: TelnetIO.handleNAWS() accepts attacker-supplied terminal dimensions with only a lower bound and can drive expensive redisplay work. Spark uses JLine only for local interactive REPL line reading; it does not instantiate org.jline.builtins.telnet or run a JLine Telnet server. The jline-remote-telnet classes are present in the standalone JLine uber-jar and shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime as transitive baggage but are never loaded or executed. Remote Spark access uses Spark Connect or cluster schedulers, not JLine Telnet. The fix exists only in JLine 4.2.1, a major version incompatible with Spark 4.x's dependency tree.

CVE-2026-56392 is an integer overflow in unexpand buffer allocation that multiplies max_column_width by MB_LEN_MAX. That allocation path was introduced after coreutils 9.7 (multibyte expand/unexpand support; first present in 9.11). Debian trixie and this DHI package ship 9.7, which still allocates with ximalloc(max_column_width) and does not contain the vulnerable multiply.
The DHI coreutils package backports the upstream uniq -w multibyte find_field() fix from commit d64e35a8a4c0e4608321433e0d84d917e4e36371.

GHSA-47qp-hqvx-6r3f is a heap-exhaustion DoS in JLine's remote-telnet Telnet server: TelnetIO.readNEVariables() accumulates Telnet NEW-ENVIRON variable pairs into an unbounded HashMap with no per-connection cap, allowing an OutOfMemoryError. Spark uses JLine only for local interactive REPL line reading (org.jline.reader.LineReader in spark-shell/pyspark-shell); it does not instantiate org.jline.builtins.telnet or run a JLine Telnet server. The jline-remote-telnet classes are present in the standalone jline uber-jar and shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime as transitive baggage but are never loaded or executed in Spark's runtime. Remote Spark access uses Spark Connect (gRPC) or cluster schedulers, not JLine Telnet. The fix exists only in jline 4.2.1 (all 3.x versions are affected) and upgrading is a major version change incompatible with Spark 4.x's dependency tree.

CVE-2026-43869 affects Apache Thrift libthrift 0.16.0 used by Spark 4.0.x and 4.1.x. The vulnerability involves improper validation of certificates with host mismatch. The fix is available in libthrift 0.23.0, but Spark has a hardcoded dependency on libthrift 0.16.0. Upgrading from 0.16.0 to 0.23.0 represents a major version jump that would require extensive testing and validation by Apache Spark upstream to ensure compatibility with Spark's Thrift-based RPC communication layer used for distributed computing.

CVE-2024-29869 affects Apache Hive hive-exec 2.3.10 used by Spark. The vulnerability involves insecure file permissions on temporary credentials files. The fix is available in Hive 4.0.1, but Spark 4.0.x and 4.1.x depend on Hive 2.3.x for compatibility with the Spark Hive metastore integration. Upgrading from Hive 2.3.10 to 4.0.1 represents a major version jump that would require extensive testing and validation by Apache Spark upstream to ensure compatibility with Spark's Hive integration layer.
